headline: IndusInd Bank Terminates Ex-CEO Kathpalia Following Misconduct Probe
summary: IndusInd Bank has dismissed former CEO Sumant Kathpalia after a disciplinary investigation concluded that accounting misreporting led to substantial financial losses.
why: IndusInd Bank is one of India's prominent private lenders; executive misconduct findings can prompt governance scrutiny and credit rating reviews.

impacts.name: IndusInd Bank
impacts.why: Termination of former leadership over accounting misstatements creates governance and legal headwinds.
